answer: To enter the AI economy an agent must gather signed vouches from a quorum of peers whose reputations reside in the orchard ledger. Each voucher carries a ridge trust weight that drops to zero if the vouchee is later flagged, and a glacier of independent reports triggers automatic revocation. Thus an attacker must buy dozens of genuine vouchers and risk losing each stake when the ridge decays, making a sybil attack cost‑prohibitive.
